name: SnapDo
elevator_pitch: For busy individuals overwhelmed by complex task managers, SnapDo is an ultra-minimalist task app that captures thoughts in milliseconds. Unlike traditional apps filled with bloated menus and setup screens, SnapDo provides zero-friction instant text input paired with seamless hands-free Siri and Google Assistant integration, ensuring tasks are captured the instant they arise.
problem_statement: Traditional task management apps are bloated with features, nested folders, and multi-step creation modal dialogs. This operational friction causes users to lose focus, delay capturing urgent tasks, or abandon task tracking altogether when on the go.
solution: SnapDo streamlines task management into an ultra-minimalist, single-screen interface optimized for sub-second capture. By combining persistent quick-entry text input with hands-free voice shortcuts powered by Siri and Google Assistant integrations, users effortlessly record, view, and complete tasks without breaking their workflow.
vision: To build the world's most responsive and frictionless personal capture interface, seamlessly bridging human thought to completed action across every mobile and voice platform.
competitors:
1. Todoist: Deep features and multi-platform sync, but higher setup friction and complex UI.
2. Apple Reminders: Strong Siri integration, but lacks cross-platform parity with Google Assistant.
3. Things 3: Beautiful minimalism, but restricted to Apple ecosystem and lacks instant background voice triggers.
success_metrics:
1. Average task capture completion time under 1.5 seconds from app launch or voice shortcut trigger.
2. 30-day user retention rate > 35%.
3. > 40% of total created tasks submitted hands-free via voice assistant shortcuts.
4. Voice command parsing accuracy > 98%.
design_principles:
# Core Design Philosophy & Guidelines

### 1. Zero-Friction Capture First
Every design decision prioritizes getting thoughts into the app in under 2 seconds. The app opens directly with an active input affordance. Natural language processing parses dates, times, and priority tags on the fly, eliminating the need for modal popups, date pickers, or drop-down menus.

### 2. Extreme Visual Minimalism & OLED Dark Mode
Interface chrome is minimized or hidden. Content *is* the interface. Crisp typography hierarchy, generous touch padding, and pure OLED black dark mode options minimize cognitive load and visual fatigue during day and night usage.

### 3. Gesture-First Ergonomics
All primary list operations rely on intuitive fluid gestures:
- **Swipe Right**: Complete task with satisfying micro-animation and haptic trigger.
- **Swipe Left**: Defer or schedule task for tomorrow/later.
- **Pull Down**: Trigger instant search or create new task top-of-list.
- **Pinch In / Long Press**: Enter distraction-free Focus Mode.

### 4. Tactile & Motion Feedback
Subtle custom haptics complement visual transitions. Completing a task produces an intentional, lightweight tactile response that builds micro-reward momentum without visual clutter.

### 5. Native Voice Integration (Siri & Google Assistant)
Voice interactions are treated as first-class input mechanisms. Siri Shortcuts and Google Assistant integrations funnel voice capture directly into the primary task stream without forcing app launches or multi-step confirmation screens.

navigation_design:
# Navigation Architecture & Interaction Rules

## 1. Overview
The application uses a gesture-centric, edge-to-edge layout with zero static top headers or heavy bottom navigation bars. Secondary views are accessible via fluid horizontal and vertical swipes from the main view (`/`).

## 2. Role-Based Navigation Specification

### Role: User / Guest
- **Default Entry Point (`/`)**: Opening the app lands immediately on Today's Task List with active input affordance.
- **Gesture Navigation**:
  - **Pull Down from top**: Opens quick search or creates a new top task.
  - **Swipe Left**: Navigates to `/upcoming` (Scheduled & Deferred Tasks).
  - **Swipe Right**: Navigates to `/archive` (Completed Task History).
  - **Pinch / Tap Task**: Enters `/focus` (Distraction-Free Single-Task Focus Card).
  - **Top Corner Gear Icon / Swipe Down Secondary**: Opens `/settings` (Theme & Voice Assistant Setup).
- **Sub-View Navigation**:
  - `/settings/voice`: Siri Shortcuts configuration and Google Assistant trigger mappings.
  - `/settings/theme`: OLED true-dark mode toggle, font scaling, and haptic feedback strength.

### Role: System (Siri / Google Assistant Integration)
- Dynamic deep links: Voice shortcuts invoke background API sync or deep-link directly into `/` or `/focus`.

## 3. Dark Mode & Visual Ergonomics
- **OLED True Dark**: #000000 background option for minimal battery consumption and glare reduction.
- **Dynamic Type Support**: Supports system-level text sizing while maintaining gesture target integrity (minimum 48px touch targets).
- **Fluid Motion**: Spring-physics transitions for edge swipes with low-latency responsiveness (<16ms frame target).

key_features.feature_description: Persistent quick-input text field at the bottom of the screen with natural language date parsing (e.g., 'Buy groceries tomorrow at 5pm') and instant single-tap saving.
Native voice intent handlers for Apple Siri Shortcuts and Google Assistant App Actions, enabling hands-free task creation without unlocking or launching the app.
A ultra-clean single-list interface with fluid gesture interactions (swipe right to complete, swipe left to delete, pull to reorder) and automatic light/dark mode adaptation.
Offline-first local cache paired with sub-second WebSocket cloud synchronization to ensure zero input latency even on weak network connections.
Back-office portal providing system performance metrics, voice parsing accuracy logs, active session counts, and remote feature flag toggles.

user_stories.phase: Phase 1 - MVP Instant Capture & Voice Shortcuts
user_stories.title: Distraction-Free Theme and Focus Mode

user_story.i_want: a clean dark and light interface that eliminates visual clutter
user_story.so_that: I can focus entirely on my priorities without unnecessary UI elements

acceptance_criteria: UI respects OS theme preferences by default and allows explicit dark/light mode toggle

user_stories.title: Background Cross-Device Task Synchronization

user_story.i_want: my tasks to sync automatically across all my devices whenever changes occur
user_story.so_that: I always have an up-to-date task list on my phone, tablet, and desktop

acceptance_criteria: Changes made on one device propagate to connected devices via WebSocket within 500ms
If two devices modify the same task simultaneously, Conflict-Free Replicated Data Type (CRDT) rules resolve edits without data loss
Unauthenticated users are redirected to /login when accessing /sync settings
Only end_user role can initiate background account sync sessions
Sync failure due to network drop queues mutations locally and resumes automatically upon reconnect

user_stories.title: Offline Task Operations and Queuing

user_story.i_want: to create, edit, and complete tasks while offline without disruption
user_story.so_that: I can remain productive in low-connectivity environments like airplanes or underground transit

acceptance_criteria: All task mutations complete immediately against local IndexedDB or SQLite database while offline
An unobtrusive offline status indicator shows pending queued changes
When connection is restored, local queue flushes to cloud backend transparently
Only end_user role can access local offline storage on /tasks
Corrupted offline queue items log a telemetry warning and safely isolate without wiping valid local tasks

user_stories.title: Admin Voice and Sync Performance Telemetry

user_story.i_want: to monitor real-time sync performance, voice intent error rates, and API latency metrics
user_story.so_that: I can proactively resolve infrastructure bottlenecks and voice recognition issues

acceptance_criteria: Dashboard displays live charts for voice intent parse accuracy and sync conflict frequencies
Only admin role can access telemetry analytics at /admin/telemetry
Unauthenticated users attempting to access /admin/telemetry are redirected to /login
Admin can filter sync metrics by OS platform (iOS, Android, Web) and time range
Anomalies in voice parsing errors above 5% trigger an automated operational alert

user_stories.title: Admin User Management and System Diagnostics

user_story.i_want: to review system health and manage platform rate limits or user accounts
user_story.so_that: I can maintain system stability and assist users experiencing voice integration issues

acceptance_criteria: Admin view displays active user sessions, sync queue depth, and external API status

steps: [guest] Navigate to /signup or launch app for the first time
[guest] Enter email and password or authenticate via Apple/Google OAuth
[guest] Complete short setup wizard on /onboarding to enable Siri / Google Assistant voice shortcuts
[user] Issue voice command to device ('Hey Siri, add buy milk to SnapDo' or 'Hey Google, add buy milk on SnapDo')
[user] Assistant fires background API request to /api/v1/voice-capture
[user] System parses string and appends new task to user active list
[user] Receive immediate haptic/audio confirmation response on device
[user] Tap bottom quick-input bar, type task description, and press Enter
[user] Swipe right on a completed item to strike through and mark done
[user] Swipe left on an item to archive or delete
[admin] Authenticate with admin credentials and MFA token
[admin] Navigate to /admin/analytics to inspect real-time voice parsing failure rates and sync latency
[admin] Navigate to /admin/feature-flags to toggle experimental voice shortcuts or UI features
